title: Grace Harlowe's Return to Overton Campus
summary: "Grace Harlowe's Return to Overton Campus" by Josephine Chase is a novel published in 1915. Part of the College Girls Series, this book follows Grace Harlowe as she returns to Overton College after graduation to manage Harlowe House, choosing her "destined work" over marriage proposals. Along with her loyal friends from the Semper Fidelis society, Grace continues her mission of supporting less fortunate students while navigating the challenges and adventures of campus life in early twentieth-century America.
